relations: Press head descending onto the stacked ceramic bowls causes the upper bowl to fracture into flying shards.
Sustained downward pressure on the lower bowl cracks its rim and body into scattered fragments.
Impact between metal and ceramic releases fine dust and small pieces outward from the crush zone.
The striped base holds the stack steady while the press compresses the bowls.
